**Summary of Findings:**
- The top pairs of substances with the highest co-driver frequency are Methoxychlor & Terbutylazine, Cyanuric acid & Indeno(1,2,3-cd)pyrene, Endrin & Indeno(1,2,3-cd)pyrene, Benzo(b)fluoranthene & Iomeprol, and Carbendazim & Imidacloprid.
- For all top pairs, both substances are detected (median_concentration > 0) at the same sites, often at a substantial number of shared locations.

**Cypher Query Used:**
```cypher
// Step 1 & 2 combined: Find top pairs of substances with highest JOINT_DRIVER_WITH frequency
// and check if both are detected (median_concentration > 0) at the same sites
MATCH (s1:Substance)-[j:JOINT_DRIVER_WITH]->(s2:Substance)
WITH s1, s2, j.frequency AS frequency
ORDER BY frequency DESC
LIMIT 20

MATCH (s1)-[r1:MEASURED_AT]->(site:Site)<-[r2:MEASURED_AT]-(s2)
WHERE r1.median_concentration > 0 AND r2.median_concentration > 0

WITH s1.Name AS Substance1, s2.Name AS Substance2, frequency, collect(DISTINCT site.name) AS SharedSites
RETURN 
  Substance1, 
  Substance2, 
  frequency AS JointDriverFrequency,
  CASE WHEN size(SharedSites) > 0 THEN true ELSE false END AS BothDetectedAtSameSites,
  SharedSites
ORDER BY JointDriverFrequency DESC
```
